senses.gloss: m. (רָחַף) hovering, brooding, use of the verb רָחַף.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:8">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> top <he>מה ר׳ שנאמר להלן וכ׳</he> as the hovering mentioned there (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:11">Deut. XXXII, 11</cite>) means touching and yet not touching (not pressing), so does the hovering mentioned here (<cite ref="Genesis 1:2">Gen. I, 2</cite>) &c.
